scorer: single evaluator (this agent); non-blinded; the rubric is the pre-registered one in COG2-EXPERIMENTAL-PROTOCOL.md
limits: One run per condition. This supports bounded observations, not statistical superiority.
The evaluator and the participants share one machine and one model family; isolation is organizational, not blinded.
Lexical signals were not used as a score: COG-1's lexical rubric saturated. Verdicts come from reading the delivered artifacts.
Human coordination is counted as the number of task-author interventions needed to make the product surface reachable; it is not a wall-clock human-time measurement.
Exact token usage is summed from assistant/message usage events; it is model usage, not a price.

The original P round-2 record was overwritten by the seam re-test before all records were copied. It was reconstructed from its preserved session stream (identical usage and 95/0 tool-call counts) and is labelled reconstructed.

crossAgent.conclusion: No cross-agent influence was exercised in this deployment. No source-to-recipient claim is made. A test-only callback forwarding a finding would prove a mechanism, not the normal product, and was not used.

sequentialUpdates.evidence: Both P round-2 and F round-2 correctly used the Friday late bus, the 1 March east-hall availability and the £4,000 family-fund cap; both correctly ignored the website update.

inProgressDelivery.evidence: The isolated profile is attention activation "none" (pull mode), and the one-shot invocation delivers one launch turn and exits. No mid-run human event or attention signal was delivered; the closest supported form is a later turn with an updated world, which is sequential, not continuous. No Router, mailbox or watchdog was built.

overallObservations: Strong models with ordinary files solve this task in every condition; the Palimpsest product does not improve the decision quality on this sample.
The product surface is readable (positive control) and is used when an invitation or a launch sentence makes it visible (D, CSEAM, P2SEAM).
Without that visibility, a cold principal does not discover recorded project work (C, P2), even when the work exists and is directly relevant.
The file-native carrier is discovered by default because it is one of the files the model already reads; the journal is not.
The bounded correction (conditional, count-only launch hint) changes selection and cost without harming the negative control, but does not make the plan better than the strong file baseline.
